title: bug: VS Code SettingsPanel says 'Settings saved.' when the UPDATE_SETTINGS send failed
description:
Found in the CQ-I06f whole-epic review at 96f7bdd4 (I04 residual). MoeDaemonClient.sendMessage returns false when nothing was sent (MoeDaemonClient.ts:767). updateSettings (:902-904) discards that result and returns void, so SettingsPanel.handleMessage (:75-78) always shows 'Settings saved.' and disposes the panel, even while disconnected. Other routes already warn 'Not connected to Moe daemon' (e.g. TaskDetailPanel reopen).
Fix: return the boolean, and on false show a warning and keep the panel open. Add a settings-wire test.
definitionOfDone: A disconnected save shows a not-connected warning, does not say 'Settings saved.', and keeps the panel open; a connected save is unchanged.
A moe-vscode node:test covers both branches.
cd moe-vscode && npm run lint && npm run compile && npm test pass in a snapshot.

implementationPlan.description:
Write the tests first, then the fix. Reuse sendMessage's existing boolean and add no helper. Edit these three tracked files with the Edit tool only, never a shell write.
(a) tests/settings-wire.test.cjs:
- Add `warnings: []` to `seen` (:90). Add a `showWarningMessage` stub that records into it, next to showInformationMessage/showErrorMessage (:101-102). Without the stub, the panel's warning call throws TypeError, and the save catch turns that into 'Failed to save settings'.
- S1 also asserts `seen.warnings` is [].
- New S7: in withSettingsPage(STORED), keep `const socket = client['ws']` and call the real `client.disconnect()` (:739; it clears ws and sets 'disconnected'; manual, so no reconnect). Click saveBtn. Assert seen.frames is [], seen.warnings is exactly ['Not connected to Moe daemon — settings were not saved.'], info is [], errors is [] and disposes is 0. Then restore `client['ws'] = socket; client['_connectionState'] = 'connected'` and click saveBtn again on the SAME page. savedPayload(seen) passes, info is ['Settings saved.'] and disposes is 1. This proves the panel stayed open and usable.
- New S8: set `client['ws'] = { readyState: 1, send() { throw new Error('socket hang up'); }, close() {} }` and click save. Expect the same single warning, info [], errors [], disposes 0 and client.connectionState 'disconnected'. The sendMessage catch tears the socket down, and scheduleReconnect does nothing because the stub's autoConnect is false, so no timer leaks.
RED: from moe-vscode, run `node --test tests/settings-wire.test.cjs` in place. That is allowed: it transpiles in memory and writes nothing. S7 and S8 must fail and S1-S6 must pass.
(b) MoeDaemonClient.ts:902: updateSettings returns boolean, `return this.sendMessage('UPDATE_SETTINGS', settings);`. Its only caller is SettingsPanel.ts:76, and the payload does not change.
(c) SettingsPanel.ts:75-78, handleMessage 'save':
- When updateSettings returns true, keep today's showInformationMessage('Settings saved.') and this.dispose().
- Otherwise call vscode.window.showWarningMessage('Not connected to Moe daemon — settings were not saved.') and do NOT dispose, so the form keeps the user's edits for a retry.
- Use the same U+2014 em dash as TaskDetailPanel.ts:258 and PlanReviewPanel.ts:332.
- Add no import: the harness's closed require map allows only vscode.
- Error handling: keep the existing try/catch ('Failed to save settings: <msg>') for a thrown error exactly as it is.
GREEN: the same node --test run passes 12/12. The architect prototyped exactly this in scratch: RED gave 10 pass with S7 and S8 failing, and GREEN gave 12/12.
implementationPlan.note: RED: S7/S8 failed, S1-S6 passed. GREEN: 12/12 in-place node --test. Peer dirty .moe files untouched.

comments.content:
Governor planner note (governor-4764040b, 17:45Z): this row was promoted from BACKLOG under the human's standing delegation, as off-lane work for idle seats.

JetBrains parity: JetBrains is the primary IDE (CLAUDE.md), and it has a sibling of this bug.
- `moe-jetbrains/.../toolwindow/MoeSettingsDialog.kt:130-131`: the save action calls `service.updateSettings(settings)`, then `close(OK_EXIT_CODE)` unconditionally.
- `MoeCommandSender.updateSettings` (:74-83) returns Unit. When `!ensureConnected()`, it returns silently after only a `log.warn` and `onDisconnected()`.
- `sendMessage` (:301-308) swallows dispatch exceptions.
- So JetBrains shows no false "Settings saved.", but its dialog still closes and the edits are lost silently while disconnected.

Scope:
- Keep this row to its VS Code DoD.
- The JetBrains half is being routed as a sibling row (#governors).
- Don't widen this plan into moe-jetbrains, because QA checks against this DoD.
- If you change `MoeDaemonClient.updateSettings` to return the send result, mirror the shape the JetBrains sibling will use: a Boolean "sent" result the caller checks before closing. That keeps the two clients' contracts parallel.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: In the VS Code Moe Settings panel, Save says 'Settings saved.' and closes only when MoeDaemonClient handed the UPDATE_SETTINGS frame to the socket. When sendMessage returns false (not connected, socket not OPEN, or the send threw), the panel shows the warning 'Not connected to Moe daemon — settings were not saved.' and never claims success. It also stays open with the user's edits, so a Save after reconnecting works from the same panel.
acceptanceCriteria: A disconnected save sends no frame, shows exactly the not-connected warning, shows no 'Settings saved.' and no error, and leaves the panel undisposed (settings-wire S7).
A save whose ws.send throws gets the same warning, no success message and no dispose, and the client ends 'disconnected' (S8).
A retry from the same still-open page after reconnecting sends exactly one six-key UPDATE_SETTINGS frame, says 'Settings saved.' and disposes once (S7 second half).
A connected save is unchanged: one frame, info ['Settings saved.'], no warnings, no errors, one dispose (S1, strengthened with warnings []).
The step-2 snapshot gate exits 0 with 350 tests and 0 failures.
invariants: The panel is disposed only after sendMessage returned true.
A save never shows both a success message and a warning.
No frame reaches the socket while the client is not connected.
compatibility: The UPDATE_SETTINGS wire payload stays the same six form keys; S1-S6 assertions are unchanged.
The 'Failed to save settings: <msg>' error path for a thrown error is unchanged.
updateSettings has one caller (SettingsPanel.ts:76). The other void senders are untouched.
No daemon, proxy or JetBrains change.

MoeDaemonClient.ts:902 updateSettings currently returns void and drops that result. disconnect() is at :739 and the connectionState getter at :569.
SettingsPanel.ts:75-78 always shows 'Settings saved.' and disposes.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
Rejected: checking client.connectionState in the panel before sending. It races, and it misses the case where the send throws. sendMessage's boolean is the single source of truth.
Rejected: throwing from updateSettings on false. approveTask, rejectTask and reopenTask all return boolean, and a throw would surface as the 'Failed to save settings' error toast instead of the established not-connected warning.
Rejected: queueing the save until reconnect. That is scope creep, and no other route queues.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
settings-wire.test.cjs runs the REAL MoeDaemonClient, SettingsPanel and media/settings.js in vm contexts. The require maps are closed: a new import in SettingsPanel breaks every row. The tests simulate the connection through client['ws'] and client['_connectionState']. The stub's autoConnect=false keeps scheduleReconnect from arming a timer. Tests transpile with TS6 transpileModule and do no type check, so `npm run compile` is the type gate.
Baseline: the in-place `node --test tests/settings-wire.test.cjs` gives 10/10 in about 0.5 s under WSL. moe-vscode has had no commits since 96f7bdd4, the I06f A4 gate: 348 tests, 344 pass, 4 skip.
